reviews.comment: Professor Rosen is probably one of the best lecturers I've had. Easy to follow and he breaks things down to make sure everyone understands. He has good energy when teaching and does well at keeping you engaged. Lectures are recorded so it's easy to review material before exams. He's also more than willing to provide help outside of class.

This guy reminded me of Radiohead. He is a very brilliant professor and its cool when he talks about his university research job. He cares a lot about each student and really wanted us to learn and beenfit from the material. Love this guy

This class is very easy if you can understand the basics of 3d design. He does a good job explaining the material. As long as you pay attention in lecture the in class work and homework should be simple. There is a semester long project that goes through the design process and depending on the prompt might actually be enjoyable.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Jonathan Weaver-Rosen is a new instructor in the department, but he makes sure that the class understands the material and he explains the topics really well since he has industry experience. This course is already hard given that its coding intensive and there's a whole-semester project, but as long as you are engaged he will help you.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Weaver-Rosen was a fresh Ph.D. graduate when he started teaching in the Fall of 2021. He has a passion for everything he teaches. Speaking more specifically to MEEN 357, the class is Python-heavy and HWs are Python-based mechanical engineering analysis probs. Dr. Weaver-Rosen made tests similar to practice exams. Go to Python help desk!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria
